game.title: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

lede: New England Patriots carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Miami Dolphins +7.5 with a fair total of 41.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Miami Dolphins pass offence vs New England Patriots pass defence, which sits −0.249 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: New England Patriots and Miami Dolphins have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
